newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends on lows on commercial selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends on lows on commercial selling.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended at or near their lows on commercial selling, traders said.

"Cargill and UGG sold July and August. Crushers bought August. Exporters bought November at $344.50 and $344 with the Pools selling," a canola trader said. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -6.06 Wednesday from -1.59 Tuesday. Fifty Aug-Nov spread at $10.

August canola fell $9.50 to $354.50, November lost $4.40 to $344.20. September flax lost $4.50 to $283 on hedge selling, November fell $4 to $281 as locals bought scale down. July-Sep flax spread at $37, Sep-Nov was bid at $2.
October western barley lost $1.90 to $126.80, December down $1.70 to $127.80 in light featureless trade. Volume 600.
October feed wheat fell $1.10 to $151.60, December down $1 to $152.20 on hedges. Oats did not trade.
Commercials sold October feed peas down US$4.40 to US$166 and December down US$3.90 to US$167.20 to PCTS, traders said. Volume was 30 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, feed peas).
